# osl-ephys

> osl-ephys is a Python toolbox for analysing electrophysiological data (MEG, EEG and OPM) from the raw recording to parcellated source-space time courses: YAML-driven preprocessing run in parallel over a dataset, a MaxFilter wrapper, coregistration and volumetric source reconstruction with RHINO (FSL surfaces, LCMV beamforming, minimum norm), parcellation with leakage correction and sign flipping, quality control reports, and GLM-Spectrum sensor-level statistics.

osl-ephys was developed by the OHBA Methods Group at the University of Oxford. It builds on MNE-Python and works hand in hand with osl-dynamics, which models the dynamics of the parcel time courses osl-ephys produces.

If you use osl-ephys, please cite: van Es, M. W. J., Gohil, C., Quinn, A. J., and Woolrich, M. W. (2025). osl-ephys: a Python toolbox for the analysis of electrophysiology data. Frontiers in Neuroscience, 19, 1522675.

## Documentation

- [Installation](https://osl-ephys.readthedocs.io/en/latest/install.html): conda and pip installation, Oxford computers, development install.
- [Tutorials](https://osl-ephys.readthedocs.io/en/latest/documentation.html): preprocessing (manual, automatic, batch), coregistration, source reconstruction, GLM-Spectrum.
- [FAQ](https://osl-ephys.readthedocs.io/en/latest/faq.html)
- [API reference](https://osl-ephys.readthedocs.io/en/latest/autoapi/index.html): documentation for every module, class and function.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/OHBA-analysis/osl-ephys)
- [osl-dynamics](https://github.com/OHBA-analysis/osl-dynamics): the companion toolbox for dynamic network modelling.
- [osl-files](https://github.com/OHBA-analysis/osl-files): the parcellations, templates and test data both toolboxes download at runtime.
